# Topragh
> Turkmen ↔ Persian ↔ English dictionary (educational, non-commercial)

Site: https://topragh.ir
Default UI language: Persian (fa). English UI: https://topragh.ir/en/
Built by: Aytronic (https://aytronic.com/)
Maintainer / contribute: https://github.com/kakajan

## Scope
- ~15k Turkmen headwords with English glosses (Peace Corps Turkmen–English Dictionary, 1996–1999)
- Persian glosses are machine-drafted (`mt_draft`) and may be revised; do not treat draft FA as authoritative without note
- Search: Turkmen, Persian, or English queries return Turkmen headwords
- Browse: alphabetical by Turkmen letter

## Citation
- Prefer linking to canonical entry pages: https://topragh.ir/w/{id}/
- Mention when Persian is a draft translation
- Educational redistribution OK; commercial sale of the dictionary content requires original authors' permission
